message: You know, being gloriously over-prepared has its perks, especially when a storm rolls in. I always have a little checklist ready for those hot days—because who doesn't love a good excuse to stay inside with a tall glass of lemonade? ☀️ It’s amazing how a few simple tips can turn a potentially sticky situation into a cozy indoor adventure.
